<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Starshot Arrow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5342) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Attack" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=540" />
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 33

</column>

---

The greatest centaurs need not wait until their stories are over to touch the stars in the sky. You draw an arrow (or other ammunition), whisper a short invocation over it, and then Strike with a ranged weapon. The arrow becomes a bolt of starlight, changing its damage to your choice of force or spirit and granting it the effects of the [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840) rune. When the arrow Strikes its target, it unravels into a constellation of starlight that wraps around the target's limbs, imposing a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 2d4 rounds or [immobilizing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) it if the Strike was critical hit. The target can untangle itself by spending an Interact action to break free.
name: Starshot Arrow
